# Pipe

## Example

The traits of the picture above:

```python
ai.Pipe(value=True, label="Pipe tee", shape="tee")
```

| Trait | Type | Default | Set by | Description |

| `flow_animation` | boolean | `true` | host | Animate a moving pattern while flowing (off when reduced motion is requested). |
| `flow_direction` | `"forward"`, `"reverse"` | `"forward"` | host | Direction of the moving pattern. |
| `fluid_color` | string | `""` | host | CSS color of the fluid; unsafe colors are ignored (SEC-002). |
| `mode` | `"control"`, `"indicator"` | `"indicator"` | host | "control": the user sets the value; "indicator": display only. |
| `rotation` | `0`, `90`, `180`, `270` | `0` | host | Rotation in degrees. |
| `shape` | `"straight"`, `"elbow"`, `"tee"`, `"cross"` | `"straight"` | host | Unrotated: straight left to right, elbow left to bottom, tee left to right with a branch to the bottom, cross all four sides. |
| `size` | array | `[80,80]` | host | [width, height] in CSS pixels. |
| `thickness` | number | `14` | host | Pipe thickness in pixels. |
| `value` | boolean | `false` | host | True while the fluid flows. |
